title: Снизить шанс мутации из фито в зоо
details: Снизить вероятность мутации типа питания с PHOT (фито) на ZOOP (зоопланктон) в системе мутаций генома. Текущий шанс ~0.5 в MAJOR_DIET_RATE. Цель: 0.3 или 0.2.
notes: Reduced MAJOR_DIET_RATE from 0.5 to 0.3 in config.py. Lowers PHOT to ZOOP diet mutation probability (and all diet mutations) from 50% to 30% per major mutation event. Asymmetric weights in weighted_diet preserved (PHOT->ZOOP=0.1 still 3x rarer than PHOT->POLY=0.3). Verified with 1000-mutation distribution test. No Cython rebuild needed. All tests passed.
